title: Build evidence before granting decision authority
description: Select a consequential change, add independent challenge, and complete reproducible controls. The gate distinguishes offline evidence from permission to affect customers, capital, or markets.

controls.label: Reproducible lineage
controls.detail: Freeze training data, labels, transformations, model, policy, and evaluation versions.

controls.label: Independent validation
controls.detail: A qualified party challenges assumptions, implementation, limitations, and outcome evidence.

controls.label: Decision reasons
controls.detail: The policy can produce specific, accurate reasons and preserve them with the decision record.

controls.label: Deterministic limits
controls.detail: Hard exposure, eligibility, velocity, or loss boundaries remain outside the learned model.

controls.label: Tested rollback
controls.detail: The team can restore the incumbent model and policy without losing queued decisions or evidence.

controls.label: Monitoring owner
controls.detail: Named owners receive thresholds for data, scores, actions, outcomes, overrides, and incidents.

scenarios.label: Change a credit threshold
scenarios.detail: A calibrated score is unchanged, but the approval policy would expand or restrict access.
scenarios.consequence: Customer access, adverse-action reasons, portfolio mix, and review volume can change immediately.

scenarios.label: Refresh a fraud model
scenarios.detail: New data improves offline ranking but changes challenge and decline traffic.
scenarios.consequence: False declines, fraud loss, customer friction, and manual-review queues trade off at the operating point.

scenarios.label: Promote a trading strategy
scenarios.detail: A candidate survives a walk-forward test and requests permission to send live orders.
scenarios.consequence: Capital exposure, market impact, execution errors, and correlated positions can accumulate faster than model monitoring reacts.

scenarios.label: Add a vendor risk signal
scenarios.detail: A third-party feature enters a consequential score with limited visibility into its construction.
scenarios.consequence: Unknown provenance, outages, policy mismatch, and unstable reason codes can affect every downstream decision.
